hero.heading: Model to deployment in 15 Minutes
hero.subtitle: ModelForge bridges training and deployment. Quantize, compile, and merge neural networks with your firmware.

code.heading: Hello world in three lines
code.subtitle: We invisibly map AI cores to your host drop your model straight into your existing application.

articles.title: No Proprietary IDEs
articles.description: Everything happens within the standard Eclipse IDE you already know with easy-to-use APIs.

articles.title: A Single Line of Inference
articles.description: Your heavy, quantized neural network is distilled into a highly optimized object file. You call it just like any other standard C function.

articles.title: The End of Glue Code
articles.description: ModelForge's dual-compiler architecture natively links your embedded DSP/sensor code with the AI execution in one seamless build.

coming_soon.heading: Test on the metal, without the metal.
coming_soon.subtitle:
Validate your build in a virtual sandbox,
no need to wait for hardware.
coming_soon.card_description: Complete virtual validation environment for testing your builds before hardware arrives.

modules.heading: From bench validation to volume production.
modules.subtitle: A seamless toolchain is useless if hardware can't integrate. Move from software validation to deployment instantly with our modular edge ecosystem.

modules.title: GPX Evaluation Kits (DVKs)
modules.description: Stop fighting with breakout boards. Our fully integrated Evaluation Kits come equipped with standard interfaces, allowing you to plug in your cameras, microphones, and industrial sensors out-of-the-box for immediate physical validation.

modules.title: Production-Ready SOMs
modules.description: Skip the nightmare of custom RF and power routing. Drop our high-density System-on-Modules (SOMs) directly into your custom carrier boards. They're engineered for extreme space-constrained environments, radically accelerating your time-to-market.

copilots.heading: Your deployment co-pilots.
copilots.subtitle: A seamless toolchain is useless if hardware can't integrate. Move from software validation to deployment instantly with our modular edge ecosystem.

copilots.title: Exhaustive Documentation
copilots.description: No disorganized wikis. Access the fully searchable ModelForge deployment guide, comprehensive DSP/Pre-processing C-libraries, and lower-level hardware API references.

copilots.title: 10 Minutes to Mastery
copilots.description: Get up and running visually. Access our self-serve library of YouTube masterclasses walking you step-by-step through everything from model porting to integrated compilation.

copilots.title: Your Technical Copilots
copilots.description: Skip the generic help desk. Get direct, architectural-level support from our Field Application Engineers. We will handhold your team to help optimize your specific neural network and heterogeneous build.
